p: Crawley is surrounded by offices and business parks, so it's no surprise that karting is a popular pick for work outings. Unlike a dreary away day, it gets everyone talking, and you'll find out more about your colleagues in one race than in a year of meetings.

For the best results, think about the format. A team-style event, where colleagues are split into squads and points are totted up, means it's not just about the fastest driver. Ask about group packages when you book; venues like this often have options that suit corporate groups.

Do make sure everyone feels welcome. Not everyone will be confident behind the wheel, so it's worth reassuring the nervous ones that they'll get a full briefing and that the timing means they're mostly racing against themselves.
Crawley station and Three Bridges both have good links to London and Brighton, which helps if colleagues are travelling in from different offices.

After the racing, Tilgate Park is the town's big green escape, with lakes, woodland walks and a nature centre that's popular with families. Gatwick being on the doorstep also makes it a handy activity for anyone with time to kill before a flight, as long as you leave plenty of time to get to the terminal.
